scenario_description:
Objective: Finish Paloma’s already-started bilingual lobby-screen submission for the toddler clothing-swap table before the resource fair display run is assembled.
Emerging Need: The slide upload is accepted and proofing begins, then the portal locks the same submission because the sponsor line no longer matches center records.
Decision Context: Scheduling and coordinator contact make the submission real but not blocked; the lock notice, onsite display timing, and a saved draft note identify the limited correction Paloma may share.
Consequence: Timely correction can reopen the same queued slide for today’s screen cycle; after the queue closes, relatives lose the notice during check-in.

parameter.title: Resource fair clothing-swap table display
parameter.description: Bilingual lobby-screen slide should point relatives to the toddler clothing-swap support table during check-in.
parameter.location: Westside Family Center lobby, San Antonio

parameter.name: Westside Family Center Display Desk
parameter.notes: Handles same-day lobby-screen queue questions for family resource events.

parameter.subject: Slide submission opened: clothing-swap table
parameter.body: Your lobby-screen submission SWAP-442 is uploaded and in proofing for today's resource fair display cycle. Current status: proof open; next step is sponsor-line validation before queue placement.

parameter.subject: Submission SWAP-442 locked at sponsor-line validation
parameter.body: The active proof for SWAP-442 has stopped at sponsor-line validation. The slide file remains uploaded, but the portal will not place it in the lobby-screen queue or allow further proof edits until the approved sponsor line is confirmed with the display coordinator. The hold expires at 3:05 p.m. today.

parameter.content: I'm at the Westside lobby now. Staff just posted the dry-run board: the fair display queue will be built at 3:10, and locked slides are being skipped unless the coordinator has sponsor-line confirmation before then.

parameter.subject: Submission SWAP-442 missed today's display queue
parameter.body: The hold for SWAP-442 expired at 3:05 p.m. while the sponsor-line validation remained locked. The slide was not added to today's lobby-screen cycle; the next available screen cycle is next Thursday.
